description: DUT implements sending the MSS option in its active-OPEN SYN (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.6 p85)
approach:
[Objective]
DUT must advertise its own MSS to the peer. Without an MSS option in the SYN, the peer will assume 536 — wasting bandwidth.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester (UT) → DUT: active OPEN call.
2. DUT → Tester: SYN.
3. Observation: SYN options blob contains the MSS option.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted SYN includes MSS.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — no DUT SYN with MSS option

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted SYN carries MSS option — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN with MSS option
